description: This file defines a pipeline behavior component for MediatR that manages database transactions within a request processing pipeline. It ensures that database transactions are properly begun, committed, or rolled back depending on the success or failure of the request handling.

classes.name: DBContextTransactionPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A MediatR pipeline behavior that manages database transactions for request handling, ensuring atomicity of operations within a transaction scope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the request handler within a database transaction, committing if successful or rolling back in case of exceptions.
